rule: Public national and settlement statistics are opening-year snapshots, refreshed once annually on day 1 month 1. Completed prior-year developments appear at that tick. Later enacted local, personal and project records retain their own occurrence dates. No future-year outcome is exposed by a forecast.
preserve: world-year68.json and WORLD-YEAR68.md remain unchanged; prior projections are historical snapshots.

veyrasse_capital_cutoff.basis: Itemised year-end vouchers have not been recorded. Neutral time apportionment of the first 19/01 cumulative construction return from mobilisation to cutoff, rounded to 1,000. This is an annual treasury estimate, not a new transaction. Full later project accounts stay unchanged. A later cumulative actual expense replaces this estimate rather than being added to it.
